title: Best OP Auto Fish Auto Sell Auto Bait Auto Skill Boss
features:
Ronix Hub - Heavyweight Fishing

Main
- Auto Fishing runs the loop with Auto Cast, Auto Reel and Auto Catch
- Catch Delay slider from 0 to 2 seconds, Infinite Cast to keep the line out, and Anti AFK
- Auto Equip Best Rod by weight, count or awaken level, checked every few seconds
- Equip any rod or bait you own from a list, and put a skill on the V or X slot
- Auto Use Skill on V, X, C or Z every 1 to 30 seconds, plus a Use Skill Now button
- Auto Boss Skill presses a second chosen skill slot once every second

Sell and Buy
- Auto Sell on a timer from 5 to 300 seconds, or only when your bag fills
- Sell At % Full and Min Weight sliders, Teleport to Seller First, and Sell All Now
- Auto Buy Bait with bait type, amount up to 100 and an interval from 30 to 600 seconds
- Teleport to Bait Shop First before each buy, plus a Buy Bait Now button

Teleports
- Sell, bait, rod, skill, boss, boat and set spawn NPCs in one tap
- Spawnpoint list plus buttons for all 11 isles, Beginning Isle to World Angler Isle

Boats
- Pick a boat from the shop list to buy it, and a Spawn Boat button

Codes
- Redeem any code with the known codes listed, and WalkSpeed up to 5x

Player Info
- Live cash, crystal, level, EXP, heaviest fish, fish caught and bag space
- Also shows your equipped rod and bait, top 10 fish, bait counts and owned rods

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
